delivery.title: Where push arrives
delivery.none: No device is registered for push on this account yet. Turn on Push notifications above and allow notifications when your phone asks.

email.footnote: Receipts and sign-in emails are always sent. We never email marketing to clients.

sms.title: Text messages
sms.intro: Appointment confirmations, reminders and changes from the salons you book with, sent as SMS to the number below. Optional, and never marketing.
sms.switchOffToChange: Switch texts off to change the number.
sms.usCanadaOnly: US and Canadian mobile numbers only.
sms.legalNote: The text below is the SMS consent wording, in English.
sms.footnote: Replying STOP to any text turns this off; HELP gets you support. We will not share your number with third parties for promotional or marketing purposes.
sms.enterNumberFirst: Enter a US mobile number first.
sms.turnedOff: Text messages off. You will not be texted.

switch.on: On — reply STOP to any text to opt out
switch.stopped: Off — you replied STOP to a text. Reply START or switch on to resume
switch.termsChanged: Our text terms changed — turn on again to continue
